title: Registry mechanism demonstration (Tier 1, superseded)
description: Demonstrates the artifact registry's file table, SHA-256 hashing, per-file downloads, whole-deposit zip, and version-supersession banner, using real files and real computed hashes. This is a template demonstration for the registry mechanism itself — it is not a published methodology artifact from any initiative, and carries no fraud-detection content. Superseded by REGISTRY-DEMO-0001-v2.

title: Registry mechanism demonstration (Tier 1, current)
description: Revised version of the registry mechanism demonstration. Demonstrates that a revision publishes at a new identifier rather than editing the original in place, and that both versions stay live and cross-linked. This is a template demonstration for the registry mechanism itself — it is not a published methodology artifact from any initiative.

title: Registry mechanism demonstration (Tier 2)
description: Demonstrates the Tier 2 artifact page: the file table and full SHA-256 hashes still display, but the download links are replaced by a verification link, since Tier 2 artifacts are available only to verified institutions. This is a template demonstration for the registry mechanism itself — it is not a published methodology artifact from any initiative.
